title: Mountaindale Cabins and RV Resort — as-built network (public)
scope: As-built (current) network including Ubiquiti airMAX PtP/PtMP backhauls. No planned or future gear/routes.

source.note: Approved corrections are applied in this derived data; live Google Earth has not been re-exported, so its match is unverified.

sources: Mountaindale_Network_2026-11-06.kml (Google Earth export, predates final live-Earth edits)
asbuilt_inventory.json (parsed from that KML; D-approved name/uplink corrections)
provenance.derived_text_fixes: The 35 approved checklist corrections are applied here as a transparent interim (see asbuilt_full_local.json corrections_checklist / checklist_fixes_applied_in_derived).

earlier_review.meaning: Recorded before the sampled JPEG registration. It meant the affine was not yet accepted and must not move equipment pins.

atlas_review.note: Sampled registration later validated the full-frame image transform. Approximate horizontal estimates use that affine. Ground survey remains false. The validated raster affine does not move disputed equipment pins; Site 96 stays where it was exported.

coordinate_note: lon/lat copied unchanged from the KML export (WGS84). Atlas owns map alignment and distances. No coordinates were snapped or moved.

altitude_note.text: Raw source altitude from KML <coordinates>. All 86 Point geometries lack altitudeMode, so they default to clampToGround and viewers ignore this value; LookAt absolute altitude applies only to the camera. No vertical-datum provenance. Never a mounting height and never validated terrain height. null = no altitude in source (049-USW-Flex).
altitude_note.mount_height_field: devices[].mount_height is set only where the source description states a Height line.

display_rule: Overlapping pins: no display offsets are stored. Use view-only screen-space clustering or spiderfy with leader lines; never persist offsets or measure distances to them.

pending_review.item: Live Earth unverified; a fresh export is pending. Re-run the generator and confirm all 35 checklist rows are reflected in the source.

Site 96 pins unresolved: NB5AC-STA-96 37.512 m and NSL5AC-AP-57-75-98 19.725 m from 096-USW-Flex-East (radios 17.933 m apart). Needs ground truth. The validated image transform does not move these pins.
049-USW-Flex is an approximate pavilion-stack position (checklist), not an independent switch survey; altitude null.
098-UAP-M cabin mounting tentative (no explicit mounting text).
045-UAP-U7O and 046-UAP-M service-area tags are tentative (uplink-based). Groups can change without affecting connectivity.
Image transform is validated for approximate horizontal distance. Ground accuracy is unverified. That affine is not used to correct disputed equipment pins.
